description: This file is a shell script used for testing the unique abbreviation of SHA-1 hashes in git index lines. It contains setup code, test expectations, and commands to verify that abbreviated hashes are handled correctly without ambiguity.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Generates a SHA-1 or SHA-256 object ID based on input value.

methods.name: test_oid_cache
methods.description: Sets up a cache of test object IDs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a block of code to be executed as a successful test case.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
